verses.html: A Song or Psalm of Asaph. Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.text: A Song or Psalm of Asaph. Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.title: A Song or Psalm of Asaph.
verses.titleHtml: A Song or Psalm of Asaph.

verses.html: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.text: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

verses.html: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.text: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

verses.html: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

verses.html: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.text: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

verses.html: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.text: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

verses.html: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.html: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.text: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

verses.html: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.text: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

verses.html: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.text: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

verses.html: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.text: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

verses.html: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

verses.html: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.text: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

verses.html: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.text: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

verses.html: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.text: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

verses.html: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
verses.text: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

verses.html: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.text: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

verses.html: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.text: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
